say:5:1321783003:0.text: The thick, beautiful snow... the shimmering decorations of the Snowspire Festival...
say:5:1321783003:0.source_cn: ……树上的旗子是冬日祭典的装饰……这么厚的雪……

say:6:1321783004:0.source_cn: 为什么会有这样的画？亚莲娜什么时候参加了祭典……或者，...

choice_prompt:7:1321783004.male: Why is there such a painting? When did Yolena attend the festival? Is this some kind of cruel joke?!

say:8:1321783005:0.text: When...? When did she give this to you? This... this is her handwriting. I'd know it anywhere.
say:8:1321783005:0.source_cn: 这幅画……笔迹……这的确是亚莲娜的笔迹……我怎么会认不...

say:9:1321783006:0.text: I saw her learn to write, her little hands gripping the quill as her teacher guided her. And I was there when she first mixed colors to paint her first unicorn.
say:9:1321783006:0.source_cn: 是我看着教师教她写字，我看着她学会混合颜料，在画板上画...

say:10:1321783007:0.text: Every piece she created, I preserved. I dusted them off every day, so they'd remain as perfect as the day she made them.
say:10:1321783007:0.source_cn: 殿下的每一幅画，我都好好地保存着……每一天，我都会拂去...

say:11:1321783008:0.text: Your Highness, you can finally paint again. You haven't picked up a brush in so long.
say:11:1321783008:0.source_cn: ……殿下，您终于又能画画了……您已经好久好久没有拿起画...

say:12:1321783009:0.text: Look... your snowman is smiling so brightly. I haven't been this happy since you got sick. You must've been so happy to join in the Snowspire Festival...
say:12:1321783009:0.source_cn: 殿下，您的雪人是在笑着呢……自从您生病之后，您再也没笑...

say:13:1321783010:0.text: Dura above, your wish really came true, didn't it? I wish you could always be this happy, Your Highness...
say:13:1321783010:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上……您的心愿真的实现了……！我……我多希望您能...

say:15:1321783011:0.text: I share your pain. However, Her Highness wouldn't want this. She wouldn't want you to shackle yourself to sorrow.
say:15:1321783011:0.source_cn: ……请节哀，莉娅女士。公主殿下一定不想看到您伤心的样子……

say:19:1321783013:0.text: The Hypogean influence is fading from her body... Incredible.
say:19:1321783013:0.source_cn: 她身上的恶魔之力在逐渐褪去……真是不可思议。

say:22:1321783014:0.text: It seems she has finally accepted the truth about Princess Yolena's death.
say:22:1321783014:0.source_cn: 这说明莉娅女士终于接受了亚莲娜公主去世的真相。

say:23:1321783015:0.text: Though it pained her, it was kinder in the end to pull her from her delusions and help her confront the reality of the situation.
say:23:1321783015:0.source_cn: 虽然有些残忍，但比起生活在虚假的幻境里，能认清现实总归...

say:24:1321783016:0.text: I agree. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please use your magic to thoroughly cleanse her of any Hypogean influence.
